result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly, but one restaurant card shows a broken numeric value in place of a delivery fee, and there is a minor inconsistency in the favorite (heart) button styling between the two 'Popular right now' cards.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Smash Bros Burgers card shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid price, indicating an unparsed/undefined delivery fee value leaking into the UI.
issues.suggestion: Guard the price formatter against null/undefined/non-numeric values — fall back to a real fee, '€0 delivery', or hide the label entirely when data is missing.

issues.description: The favorite heart button on the pizza card in 'Popular right now' uses a dark/transparent background while the identical button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above uses a white circular background, making the controls look inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Apply a single consistent style (same background, size and icon color) to all favorite buttons across cards.
